name: research-library
description: Source-grounded research with a categorized local knowledge library.

interface.shortDescription: Research from sources and preserve verified knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves existing knowledge first, gathers bounded primary-source evidence, verifies important claims, and stores durable findings in a categorized local Markdown library.
defaultPrompt: Research this thoroughly and save the verified findings.
Investigate this question using primary sources.
What does my research library already know about this?
